decision_conditions: INFORMATIVE: The applicant is advised that this decision notice grants approval of details in relation to Condition 7 of planning permission P2025/3450/S73 dated 21/05/2026 insofar as it relates to parts A, B, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K and L only of the condition. The applicant is advised that in order to fully discharge Condition 7, further details must be submitted in regard to Part C of the condition.
description: Approval of details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 7 (Inclusive Design Details - excluding part c) of planning permission ref. P2025/0313/FUL dated 25/09/2025 (as varied by planning permission ref. P2025/3450/S73 dated 21/05/2026). ‘Demolition of existing mansard roof extension and replacement with a part 4th and 5th floor roof extension to provide additional hotel accommodation and refurbishment and reconfiguration of an existing hotel and public house (Sui Generis).’
